text:
maria_cs: FYI — 8 onboarding tenants experienced delayed activations (approx 22:30–23:10 UTC) due to a webhook retry storm from our ingestion queue. Drafting a customer status note + office hours. Need eng/PM sign-off and renewal uplift mitigation suggestions. @jamal_se @emma_pm

jamal_se: on it. saw spike in webhook retries from our third-party queue handler, cascade hit our task workers. I’ll prioritize a hotfix to rate-limit retries. ETA 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

emma_pm: thanks jamal. for comms: propose two messages — (1) immediate status update (what happened, impacted window, action we're taking) and (2) follow-up RCA with timeline + mitigations. also recommend offering 1 month free for the most-high-risk renewals (we can flag).

leo_sales: pls flag accounts with renewal windows in next 30 days. I can prep tailored outreach if we offer credits. sending list to maria_cs. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: copying proposed customer note below — open to edits. want to push this in next 30m.

maria_cs: ```
Hi <Customer Name>,
We experienced a short delay affecting onboarding activations between 22:30 and 23:10 UTC on 03/22. This was caused by an unusually high rate of webhook retries that temporarily overloaded our ingestion workers. We mitigated the issue by applying temporary rate limits and restarting affected workers.
Impact: delayed activations for a subset of new tenants (8). No data was lost.
Next steps: we are rolling a permanent retry-throttling fix and will follow up with an RCA within 48 hours. We’re scheduling office hours for affected customers to help catch up activations and answer questions.
We apologize for the disruption — we’re also offering a one-time credit for impacted customers.
Sincerely,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

sam_eng: small suggestion — remove 'restarting affected workers' from the immediate note, that reads like an internal op. maybe say 'we performed targeted remediation to restore normal throughput.' keeps it customer-safe.

maria_cs: good call, updated.

opsbot: Incident detected: webhook-retry-storm #INC-2026-0316 created. Priority: P2. Current status: remediation in progress. Affected tenants: 8.

jamal_se: hotfix deployed to staging, will roll to prod on canary in 20m with traffic cap. patch: add exponential backoff + global rate cap at 50r/s. monitoring dashboard wired.

emma_pm: office hours — propose 48h window: Thu 11:00–12:00 PDT and Fri 16:00–17:00 CET. Maria, can you include signup link in customer note?

maria_cs: yes — will include calendar invite link and support contact. adding registration CTA and 'we’ll proactively reschedule activation slots' line for impacted tenants.

leo_sales: once you publish, I’ll reach out to 3 renewal-risk accounts and offer dedicated 1:1 to walk through catch-up plan + credit. please mark those accounts with tag cs:renewal_risk.

olivia_exec: keep execs informed with a brief after the RCA. include estimated financial exposure and affected ARR bucket. cc me on the summary.

maria_cs: will send initial note to affected contacts in next 25m. action items: jamal — monitor canary and confirm 30m, sam — review final customer wording, emma — set up office hours link, leo — prepare renewal outreach list, olivia — await RCA summary.

sam_eng: reviewed wording, lgtm for sending. small edit: change 'one-time credit' to 'one-time account credit' for clarity.

maria_cs: sent. draft copy sent to affected tenants and calendar invites created. will post RCA thread here once we have timeline. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
